# Proto definitions for Xynq

This includes the protobuf definitions for messages between:

1. daemon & native app (intra-device): IPC protocol
2. daemon & relay server (inter-device): QUIC protocol

**Protobuf definitions**: [Buf repo](https://buf.build/xynq-devs/xynq-proto).

**Auto-generated SDKs**: [Buf SDKs](https://buf.build/xynq-devs/xynq-proto/sdks).
